description:
Dicta Il/Dictalm 3.0 24B Thinking language model

Dicta Il/Dictalm 3.0 24B Thinking is served by Hugging Face over an OpenAI-compatible API. Requests are proxied through the UnitySVC gateway; you bring your own Hugging Face API key, so token usage is billed by Hugging Face directly and the service is free through UnitySVC.

Reach it through the UnitySVC gateway with your own Hugging Face API key (the byok channel). The endpoint accepts both OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages requests — the gateway auto-detects the dialect, translates to the upstream, and returns the response in the format you sent. See the code examples for both styles.
